scripts.check: npm run docs:refresh && npm run library:check && node scripts/validate-app.mjs
scripts.mobile:prepare: npm run docs:refresh && npm run library:check && node scripts/prepare-mobile-bundle.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npm run mobile:check && npx cap sync && npm run mobile:assets:android && npm run mobile:assets:ios
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npm run mobile:check && npx cap add android && npm run mobile:assets:android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npm run mobile:check && npx cap add ios && npm run mobile:assets:ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run mobile:prepare && npm run mobile:check
scripts.desktop:build:mac:x64: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:mac:arm64: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
